topics.title_en: OpenAI asks outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, to check proofs its AI produced in math, computer science, and physics
topics.summary_zh: OpenAI邀请包括诺贝尔奖得主在内的专家，验证AI生成的数学、物理及计算机科学证明
topics.summary_en: OpenAI claims its AI models have solved three major open problems in math, physics, and computer science. The company is having the proofs verified by external experts, including a Nobel laureate, with potential implications for foundational research.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 AGI加速派 / 前沿研究员
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 大模型推理架构师与前沿实验室团队
perspective_pro.point_zh: 大模型在长程推理与百年数学猜想探索中迈出了历史性一步，AI自探索与符号演绎展现了全新科学发现范式。
perspective_pro.point_en: Extended reasoning represents a historic step in exploring mathematical conjectures, opening a new paradigm for scientific discovery.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 严谨学界 / 理论数学家
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 数学家与形式化验证学者
perspective_con.point_zh: 论文正文存在大量逻辑断层与形式主义幻觉，用概率自相关拼凑严谨数理证明极具欺骗性，缺乏确定性严密结论。
perspective_con.point_en: The submission exhibits critical logical disconnects and formal hallucinations, failing to satisfy the rigorous standards of mathematical proof.

topics.title_zh: OpenAI拟接入谷歌TPU，试图摆脱英伟达依赖
topics.title_en: Source: OpenAI, a major Nvidia customer, plans to buy Google's TPUs; a job listing shows it seeks an engineer to "lead the optimization" of its models on TPUs (Ryan Barwick/The Information)
topics.summary_zh: OpenAI正寻求招聘工程师以优化模型在谷歌TPU上的性能，意在将算力底座多元化
topics.summary_en: OpenAI is hiring an engineer to lead model optimization for Google's TPUs. This move marks a strategic shift for the Nvidia-heavy user to diversify its compute infrastructure and hedge against single-vendor supply chain risks.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 资本军备派 / 算力豪赌者
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 前沿模型实验室与超算集群操盘手
perspective_pro.point_zh: 下一代超级智力必须依靠超大规模自研与定制算力集群，以高息债务抢占万卡算力底座是决胜AGI的必然代价值得豪赌。
perspective_pro.point_en: Next-gen frontier intelligence requires astronomical dedicated compute; leveraging debt for massive TPU clusters is the necessary entry fee for AGI.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业实用派 / 下游开发者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 开发者工具创企 CEO 与企业架构师
perspective_con.point_zh: 高昂的硬件负债与高昂的 API 定价正在严重反噬生态，商业客户只为性价比买单，过度烧钱的巨头终将被客户用脚投票。
perspective_con.point_en: Astronomical debt and exorbitant API costs are alienating real customers. Startups and enterprise developers will swiftly switch to high-ROI alternatives.

topics.summary_zh: 谷歌发布Genie 4世界模型，集成Gemini 3.8 Flash，支持生成更长、更真实的互动场景及音频
topics.summary_en: Google announced its Genie 4 world model for generating interactive AI experiences, featuring enhanced realism, real-time prompt updates, audio generation, and a 2-minute runtime powered by Gemini 3.8 Flash for filmmakers and game developers.
